review_material.assessment: Source-level revision: the paper reports two fitted E_i-versus-tau_Q laws at T=10^-6 and T=1. The executable oracle uses the reported central fit coefficients on the visually verified common fitted-curve domain tau_Q in [100,1000]. Fit uncertainties remain metadata and are not sampled as oracle truth.

anchors.support: The source defines the dimensionless homogeneous Bose-gas model and its finite-duration chemical-potential quench.
The source defines the density-weighted velocity field, its incompressible component, and the corresponding kinetic energy.
The source defines E_i at the equilibration time.
Fitted power law E_i = (19.774 ± 5.010) × 10^4 tau_Q^{-0.971 ± 0.052} for panel (a) at T=10^-6.
Panel (a) shows E_i at T=10^-6, averaged over R=2000 realizations, error bars 1 standard deviation.
The source states that fits with exact independent variables use weighted least squares with inverse-variance weights.
Reviewer evidence confirms the fitted curve covers tau_Q from 100 to 1000.

mechanisms.statement: The incompressible kinetic energy E_i at equilibration time scales with quench duration as E_i proportional to tau_Q^{-(1+2 nu)/(1+z nu)}, with mean-field exponents nu=1/2 and z=2 giving E_i proportional to tau_Q^{-1}.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper establishes spontaneous quantum turbulence (SQT) in a newborn 2D Bose-Einstein condensate via the Kibble-Zurek mechanism, focusing on the incompressible kinetic energy spectrum and its universal scaling with quench duration. The selected cluster is the incompressible kinetic energy E_i at equilibration time as a function of quench duration tau_Q for two temperature branches (T=10^-6 and T=1).

anchors.support: The source states that dimensionless units are used throughout the manuscript.
The source defines the density-weighted velocity field and its incompressible solenoidal component, then defines the corresponding kinetic energy.
E_i is defined as (1/2) integral |u_i(r, t_eq)|^2 d^2 r = integral E_i(k) dk.
Each data point is averaged over R=2000 (T=10^-6) and R=1000 (T=1) stochastic realizations; error bars denote 1 standard deviation.

readouts.definition: Total incompressible kinetic energy of the solenoidal density-weighted velocity field at equilibration time.
